### Texas Roadhouse, Inc. to Announce First Quarter Earnings on May 7, 2026


April 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/953769211/files/doc_news/Texas-Roadhouse-Inc--to-Announce-First-Quarter-Earnings-on-May-7-2026-2026.pdf)


LOUISVILLE, Ky., April 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Texas Roadhouse, Inc. (NasdaqGS: TXRH) announced today that it will release first quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, May 7, 2026 after the market close. A conference call will follow at 5:00 PM ET and will be webcast live from the investor relations portion of the Company's website at[www.texasroadhouse.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mq5fs8a-zMFSiG6eGQLzxReiJwx2OvZGuct9WWu3kh3JsfYWzkDQvjspUOCef_NbiD1wKKgST1qdXPVKJBQP3s8a9BMFROCDF6owwC1uGfM=) .


Listeners may also access the call by dialing (888) 440-5667 or (646) 960-0476 for international calls and referencing the Texas Roadhouse, Inc. First Quarter 2026 Earnings. A replay of the call will be available until May 14, 2026 by dialing (800) 770-2030 or (609) 800-9909 for international calls and using conference ID 7714420.


**About the Company** Texas Roadhouse is a growing restaurant company operating predominantly in the casual dining segment that first opened in 1993 and today has grown to over 820 restaurants system-wide in 49 states, one U.S. territory, and ten foreign countries. For more information, please visit the Company’s Web site at[www.texasroadhouse.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mq5fs8a-zMFSiG6eGQLzxReiJwx2OvZGuct9WWu3kh2sz7OzBGudEna37VLVxEyWKaSSpI5uoO7SSzbtwa-jwx4LuXsjeJdBKzjgSOw3UeY=) .
